mentions.name: radar
mentions.description: This tool scans the user's AI development session chats, searches places they frequent, and recommends tooling, libraries, and other resources to incorporate into development practices.
mentions.problem: Keeping up with how fast things are changing.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://github.com/flippyhead/radar

I can't keep up with how fast things are changing. I built this to scan my AI dev sessions chats, search various places I frequent, and recommend tooling, libraries and all kinds of other things I might want to incorporate into my development practices.
